user.description: Choose the SPLED controller to add. Only controllers that are powered and in Bluetooth range are listed.

abort.no_devices_found: No supported SPLED controller found nearby. Make sure it is powered, in range and not connected to the phone app.
abort.not_supported: This Bluetooth device is not a supported SPLED controller.

data_description.keepalive_interval: How often the connection is checked. Dead connections are detected and re-established within this time.
data_description.min_kelvin: Color temperature of the warm white LEDs on your strip.
data_description.max_kelvin: Color temperature of the cool white LEDs on your strip.

error.invalid_kelvin_range: The warmest temperature must be lower than the coolest temperature.

device_not_found.message: Bluetooth device {address} is not in range of any adapter.

device_no_response.message: {name} did not respond. Is it powered and not connected to the phone app?

unavailable.message: {name} is not reachable right now. It will reconnect automatically.
